{{Short description|Italian economist and mathematician}}
[[File:Ricci_-_Nuova_pratica_mercantile,_1659_-_4672269.tif|thumb|''Nuova pratica mercantile'' (1659)]]

'''Francesco Ricci''' was a [[17th century|17th-century]] [[Italians|Italian]] [[economist]] and [[mathematician]] from [[Palermo]].<ref>{{Cite book|first=Giuseppe|last=Colucci|author-link=Giuseppe Colucci (antiquarian)|title=Antichità picene|location=Fermo|publisher=Dai torchi dell'autore|date=1796|volume=26|p=250|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=19Kq4vm8rskC&pg=PA250|language=it}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |title=Le scienze a Urbino nel tardo Rinascimento|url=https://books.google.com/books?hl=it&id=Laa4AAAAIAAJ|last=Gamba|first=Enrico|last2=Montebelli|first2=Vico|publisher=QuattroVenti|location=Urbino|pages=176-178|language=it|date=1988|isbn=88-392-0055-X}}</ref>
